# Space-Track GP element sets, 2026-10-29

`gp-2026-10-29.json` holds ten SGP4 element sets exactly as Space-Track.org published them in its GP class: the
field text is unchanged, a subset of the fields is kept (the OMM's mean elements, `CREATION_DATE` and `GP_ID`). They
come from the full-catalog snapshot retrieved 2026-10-29 (archived as `spacetrack/gp/2026/2026-10-29.json.gz`,
SHA-256 `a0ff07183325e857180a822e6799713f66cbbfa28ed82f6d9996e02672020a9d`), selected by catalog number:

| Role | NORAD |
| --- | --- |
| Deep space at low inclination, node near 0 (the AFSPC and improved modes part here) | 40942, 33461, 29165, 32021, 58346 |
| ISS | 25544 |
| B* 0.107 (Starlink) | 67024 |
| Perigee below 220 km | 32730 |
| 12-hour resonant | 45254 |
| Geosynchronous resonant | 29055 |

Source: USSPACECOM / 18th Space Defense Squadron, via Space-Track.org (https://www.space-track.org), redistributed
under USSPACECOM's blanket approval for basic SSA data with citation (`NOTICE.md`).
